native_B1_policy: K=1 only: use the verified frozen Phase-0B OpenROAD-native order, then re-stitch and re-route it with the same fixed Phase-0C IO policy. K>1 requires a separate executed native DFT plan and is unavailable until qualified
source_placement_policy: Use Phase-0B frozen seed-specific 3_place.odb; every method for a design, seed starts from this identical ODB
scan_port_policy: Nangate45 metal5: place each added edge pin on the nearest free Y track 140+560*n DBU, at least 1120 DBU from existing pins on that edge; relocate test_so by the same rule for every Phase-0C variant. Include all 2K SI/SO port links in the primary scan HPWL proxy
pattern_policy: Use frozen FAN PPI vectors with fixed FF bijection, tail-first parallel loading with leading zero padding on short chains
routing_screen_policy: All six predeclared families for every qualified design-seed-K; no post-hoc selection. B1 K=1 is rerouted under Phase-0C fixed IO policy.

intervention_screen.qualification: parent must be a zero-DRC verified final-campaign route; each child must preserve FF inventory and reconstruct all frozen ATPG PPI states; physical delta is port-aware HPWL proxy only

run_id_rule: first 20 hex SHA256 of canonical JSON [PACT_PHASE0C,design,physical_seed,K,method,architecture_sha256,contract_sha256]
